name: sleep_cycles
description: Plan bedtimes for a wake-up time, or wake-up times for a bedtime, in whole sleep cycles (90 minutes by default, configurable) plus the time it takes to fall asleep, across midnight, marking the options whose total sleep falls in a recommended range (default 7-9 hours for adults). Every output carries a disclaimer: not medical advice.

mode.description: wake_at lists bedtimes; bed_at lists wake-up times

catalog.source: Sleep-cycle arithmetic (about 90-minute NREM-REM cycles); recommended adult duration 7-9 h from the National Sleep Foundation (Hirshkowitz et al., Sleep Health 2015;1:40-43)
